The plate is a square plate of about 26 cm. It shows 5 small whole button mushrooms and a small pile of arugula.

Mushrooms: each is about 4 cm across and weighs roughly 12-15 g. Five of them come to about 60 g. They look cooked, with a slight sheen but no visible oil pooling, so I used about 30 kcal per 100 g.

Arugula: the pile is about 10 cm by 5 cm and loosely stacked, so about 20 g. Arugula is about 25 kcal per 100 g.
